settings.alertSchedule.onlyWhileAnImagin: EXC-01: the option's name is fixed by SQMeter spec 021 FR-017 and quoted elsewhere (the Status card's send-mode hint, alert docs); shortening it would break that link.
calibrate.check.parkBypassed: EXC-01: spec 022 requires a bypassed check to say what is bypassed and why in its own row (never the plain check name beside a pill), so the row names the check, the bypass and the test box; shortening it drops one of the three.
